item.title: Frontend-Backend Separation - Mock Data
item.description: In frontend-backend separated development, when the backend API is not finished, the frontend cannot continue debugging. So that frontend and backend can develop in parallel, the frontend needs a set of API interface environments — this is the Mock API. The diagram below lays out the development flow nicely. Without a Mock data step, frontend-backend integration takes up a great deal of time.
